Field.Name: Ready
Field.Description: Gets Designator Ready 0 - Not Ready for fire. 1 - Ready for fire

Field.Name: Safety Switch
Field.Description: Gets Designator Safety Switch 0 - Off (Fire Disabled). 1 - On (Fire Enabled)

Field.Name: Enable
Field.Description: Gets Designator HW Input status 0 - Off (Designator Disabled). 1 - On (Designator Enabled)
